3. Establishment arid
incorporation.---(1) Government shall establish an Organization to be
called the Sind Agricultural Supplies Organiza tion.
(2) The Organization shall be a
body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal, with power,
subject to the provisions of this Act, to undertake work with regard to
procuring and distributing throughout the Province agricultural inputs, namely,
seeds and fertilizers (both indigenous and imported) and hold property both
movable and immovable, and shall by the said name sue and be sued.

4. Management and
administration.- (1) The general direction and administration of the Organization
and its affairs shall vest in a Board of Members which may exercise all powers
and do all acts and things which may be done or exercised by the Organization.
(2) The Board in discharging its
functions shall be guided on questions of policy by such directions as
Government may from time to time give, and Government shall be the sole judge
as to whether a direction given to the Organization is or is not on a question
of policy.
(3) If the Board falls to obey
any direction given under subsection (2) Government may remove the Members
Including the Chairman, and notwithstanding anything contained in section 5
appoint persons in their place temporarily until fresh appointments are made
under that section.

The Board shall consist of such official and non-official Members not exceeding
seven as may be appointed by Government.
(2) Government shall appoint one
of the Members to be operational Director, who shall be responsible for-
(i) all

(ii)
procurement, handling and distribution of the agricultural In puts ;
(iii)
maintenance of proper accounts ; and
(iv) performance
of such other duties as may be necessary for the purposes of this Act or which
may be prescribed.

CHAPTER III-FUNCTIONS
12. Functions.--The
Organization shall-
(a) make suitable arrangements,
throughout the Province, on a commercial basis, for the procurement, transport,
storage and distribution to the agriculturists of improved seeds and
fertilizers : provided that as far as practicable the said supplies shall be
distributed by the Organization itself or may permit, distribution of seeds and
fertilizers through agencies such as Co-operative Societies on such terms and
conditions as it may prescribe ;
(b) assist,
encourage and promote the manufacture of Improved agricultural machinery and
implements but shall not itself undertake any such manufacture;
(c) carry out or
cause to be carried out surveys of the problems relating to application of
fertilizers and seeds in any particular area and incur expenditure on such
surveys or experiments ;
(d) contribute
towards the cost of any said surveys, experiments connected with the functions
of the Organization and undertaken or done by any other person, body or agent ;
(e) organize
publicity, dissemination of knowledge among farmers about the effects of
certified seeds and chemical fertilizers and agricultural production.

13. General powers.-(1)
The Organization may take such measures and exercise such powers as it consider
necessary or expedient for carrying out the purpose of this Act.
(2) The Organization may- incur
any expenditure, procure any sample of seeds or fertilizers from local sources
or abroad, procure any plants, machinery or materials required for its use and
may enter into any contract and do all acts and things necessary for the
performance of such contracts.
(3) The Organization may enter
into commercial transaction with any person or organization.

14. Declaration of area for
the purpose of Organization.-(1) Govern ment may, by a notification in the
official Gazette, declare any area, building not being used for residential
purposes, structure, godown or covered enclosures to be an area required
immediately for the purpose of being used by the Organization.
(2) After a notification has been
issued in respect of any area, the Organization may apply to the Collector who
after giving such reasonable notice to the owner shall deliver possession of
the said building, structure, godown or enclosure to the Organization:
Provided that no such area shall
be physically occupied by the Organi zation for its use unless the rent thereof
has been agreed upon between itself and the owner and where disagreement about
the rent has occurred the rent has been assessed by the Collector or the Rent
Controller of the area.

CHAPTER V.-FINANCES
15. Organization Fund.---(1)
There shall be a fund to be known as "Organization Fund" vested in
the Organization which shall be utilized by the Organization to meet charges in
connection with its functions under this Act, including the payment of salaries
and other remunerations to the Chairman, Members, Operational Director,
officers, advisers and servants of the Organization.
(2) The Organization Fund shall
consist of-
(i) grants made
by Government;
(ii) loans
obtained from Government ;
(iii) loans
obtained from the Commercial Banks with the special or general sanction of
Government;
(iv) all
registration fees of agencies, securities tendered by the employees, etc.,
received by the Organization ; and
(v) any other
sum duly received by the Organization.

CHAPTER VII.-AUDIT AND ACCOUNT
24. Annual report.---(1)
The Chairman shall, as soon as possible after the end of every financial year,
submit an annual report to Government on the conducts of its affairs for that
year.

CHAPTER VIII.-DISSOLUTION
25. Dissolution of the
Organization.---(1) Government may, by a notification in the official
Gazette, declare that the Organization shall be dissolved from such date as may
be specified in the notification and there upon the Organization shall stand
dissolved from that date.
(2) From the said date, all
properties, funds and dues which immediately before the said date, were vested
in or were realisable by the Organization shall vest In and be realisable by

enforceable against the Organization shall be assumed by, and be enforceable
against, Government.
